subject.title: [Bug]: Session stuck in permanent busy state after mid-turn gateway restart — no auto-recovery, only /new or /reset clears it

question: Should this issue remain the canonical mid-turn restart recovery tracker until an end-to-end restart-through-delivery proof passes, or should maintainers split the remaining slices into the related open issues?
rationale: Current main partially recovers startup-orphaned running sessions, but related open PRs and field evidence show unresolved completion and delivery behavior that automation should not collapse without maintainer proof standards.

options.title: Keep As Canonical Until E2E Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and require one proof path covering recovery prompt, final assistant persistence, channel delivery, and follow-up message processing before closing.

options.title: Split Into Related Trackers
options.body: Move delivery-hook work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90282 and stale-row/lane-release work to the existing recovery issues, then close this only after preserving the field evidence.

options.title: Fold Into Graceful Restart
options.body: Treat the remaining behavior as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57425, accepting that the narrower Telegram/macOS busy-state reproduction becomes non-canonical.

recommendation.title: Keep As Canonical Until E2E Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require one proof path covering recovery prompt, final assistant persistence, channel delivery, and follow-up message processing before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the current startup recovery path and has recent history in final-delivery routing, making them the best available owner for the proof boundary decision.
